There's not much left to say about this election that hasn't already been said. Still, it bears repeating we can't afford to sit this election out. Too much is at stake.
Health care is at stake.
Social Security is at stake.
Reproductive rights are at stake.
Gun violence prevention is at stake.
Voting rights are at stake.
Democracy is at stake.
There's an old saying attributed to Maya Angelou that says when people tell you who they are, believe them. And that's exactly what we must do with our politicians.
Republicans have told us their plans and priorities. We must believe them.
Every race is important this year. And right-wing Republicans are working to gain control everywhere , even here in Massachusetts.
We've already shared that Jim's opponent has already dumped $100,000 of his own money into this race and is willing to spend even more.
## Meet Jim
Jim McGovern represents the 2nd District of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. He has earned a national reputation as a tireless advocate for his district and as a champion for food security, human rights, campaign finance reform, social justice and peace.

## What Jim’s opponent stands for
Every race is important this year. And right-wing Republicans are working to gain control everywhere , even here in Massachusetts.
We've already shared that Jim's opponent has already dumped $100,000 of his own money into this race and is willing to spend even more.
Here's the thing, Jim's opponent has more than just a few downright-ridiculous beliefs. On some, he's gone full-extremist:
→ More than a year after the repugnant attempted insurrection on January 6, 2021, Jim's opponent was still pushing the mind-boggling big lie that Donald Trump won the election.
→ If you want to see who he'd model his service after, turn to the people he looks up to. Earlier this year, Jim's opponent re-tweeted Marjorie Taylor-Greene, as she attended a white supremacist rally.
→ Jim’s opponent wouldn’t protect the right to an abortion and a woman’s right to make her own healthcare decisions and supports Geoff Diehl , one of the most anti-choice candidates for governor in Massachusetts history.
Let's say it clearly to ensure there's no misunderstanding: Jim and his opponent have very different ideas about how we can better serve the people of Western and Central Massachusetts.
Jim believes in a bold, progressive future because every American deserves a living wage, high-quality health care, nutritious food, and the ability to retire with dignity.
